scope: Verbatim English task prompts shared by the simulation and real rows. Task setup, robot roles and scoring are separate and unchanged.

L1-01.instruction: Pick up the thick marker with the left arm and place it in the wide-mouth cup, then release it.

L1-03.instruction: Pick up the power adapter with the left arm and align its prongs with the socket holes closest to the left arm.

L1-07.instruction: Pick up the hat with the left arm, hang it on the lowest rod by its opening, and release it.

L1-08.instruction: Use the left arm to place the left cup at the center and release it, then use the right arm to nest the right cup inside it and release it.

L1-09.instruction: Pick up the flower from the left cup, insert its stem into the right cup, and release it.

L2-01.instruction: Pick up the black pen with the right arm, then grasp the cap with the left arm and pull it off along the pen’s axis.

L2-03.instruction: Hold the top book steady with the right arm, then pull the middle book out 5 cm with the left arm and release it.

L2-04.instruction: Pick up the left cup with the left arm, pour its contents into the right cup, then place it back and release it.

L2-06.instruction: Pick up the orange segment with the left arm, lift it 5–20 cm, then place it back on the box and release it.

L2-07.instruction: Use the left arm to pull the partially open top drawer out another 5 cm, then push it back to its original position.

L3-03.instruction: Hold the bottle steady with the left arm, unscrew the cap with the right arm, then lift the cap 3–5 cm away from the bottle opening.

L3-05.instruction: Pick up and hold the threaded rod steady with the right arm, then unscrew the hex nut counterclockwise with the left arm until it comes off.

L3-11.instruction: Pick up the board eraser with the left arm and erase the writing on the whiteboard.

L3-14.instruction: Use the edge of the left gripper to push the board eraser into the red region without grasping it.

L3-15.instruction: Pick up the brush next to the green box with the left arm, sweep both blue blocks into the dustpan, then set the brush down.
